---
title: "Current implementation and first use"
---

Import and run compatible Shiny apps with the bundled local R runtime. Import ZIP bundles or app.R / ui.R + server.R; missing packages are reported.

This page describes the October–November 2026 refinements. These source changes are not part of older development release downloads. Local checks are distinct from device, live-service and store acceptance.

## Build from a clean checkout

Flutter 3.47.9 / Dart 3.13.7, Python 3, JDK 17, Android SDK 36 and build-tools 35.0.0. Set JAVA_HOME and ANDROID_HOME. A device/emulator is required to install; a full Xcode installation is needed for iOS.

```sh
python3 tool/test_fetch_runtimes.py
bash tool/fetch_runtimes.sh
flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile
flutter analyze
flutter test
flutter build apk --debug --target-platform android-arm64
adb install -r build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-debug.apk
```

These commands build from this source tree. Debug APKs are development artifacts; release bundles need private signing and device acceptance. A successful build is not a store submission.

## Use and verification

Read the [repository README](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-vitrine/blob/main/README.md) for the exact application workflow, privacy/storage behavior and platform differences. The [October–November refinement record](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-vitrine/blob/main/docs/refinement-2026-10.md) records findings, changes, observed checks, deferred work and the next release action. Local checks alone do not establish remote CI results.

For published source `2dd7c9a6dd54`, [application CI](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-vitrine/actions/runs/41200149672) passed on 2026-10-31, including host tests, the offline browser Shiny journey and Android packaging. Android WebView/device acceptance and full iOS compilation remain open.

On 2026-11-02, the APK identified in the refinement record imported and ran the bundled Shiny sample offline in Android WebView on an API 35 ARM64/4 KiB emulator. Changing `mpg` to `cyl` updated the histogram and summary; the library entry and runtime worked after restart. SEND_MULTIPLE intent routing resolved, but actual incoming multi-file sharing remains untested. Physical-device/16 KiB behavior, full iOS compilation and GPL corresponding-source/distribution gates remain open.

Automatic CI APK uploads are held until the runtime source-delivery gate in [THIRD_PARTY.md](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-vitrine/blob/main/THIRD_PARTY.md) is closed; preparation, runtime tests and APK builds remain enabled.
